_comment: The externally-anchored interest floor. Per task, effect sizes from recent ACCEPTED papers; the MIE is a HIGH percentile (top-quartile) of that distribution, so the 'interesting' bar comes from the field. Values from a multi-query Semantic Scholar + Scite + arXiv pull with per-delta DOIs; unverified deltas excluded from the top-quartile. Both tasks are near-saturated, so the frontier vs raw top-quartile decision is flagged per task. Vignan verifies + signs before use.

Masked Video Distillation ViT-H over own ViT-L (CVPR 2023)

ssv2_recognition_top1.status: CITED + leniency choice APPLIED (MIE = 0.01, the FRONTIER top-quartile, lower and more lenient than the raw 0.014). SSv2 saturates hard at the >77% frontier where accepted gains are almost all below +0.01; the raw 0.014 was inflated by two low-operating-point deltas (VideoMamba +7 pt, DEAR +0.8 pt) against weaker baselines. Vignan verifies + signs. NeurIPS/CVPR/ECCV entries venue-confirmed; PatchBlender/VideoMamba/DEAR/DejaVid acceptance unverified (arXiv-indexed).

kinetics400_recognition_top1.status: CITED + leniency choice APPLIED (MIE = 0.011, the top-quartile of the 6 confirmed frontier deltas [0.001, 0.004, 0.010, 0.010, 0.011, 0.012]). The whole K400 set is already frontier SOTA-progression, so 0.011 is both the top-quartile and the lenient value, there is no lower defensible number. Vignan verifies + signs. K400 near-saturated, SOTA moved only ~89.9 (2022) to 92.1 (2024). A CoVeR +2.4 pt claim was EXCLUDED (arXiv ID/DOI unverifiable).
